stateValueStudy.scope: Separate economic value inputs from encoder activations; retain the shared fine-tuned constructor and GRU.
stateValueStudy.conditions: Two newly initialized value heads, both given the same 106 observable-state features. encoded_state additionally receives 256 encoder action features. All other weights strictly imported from the same forecast-v1 checkpoint.
stateValueStudy.training: Policy phase only: two actual own-state Train rollout collections, no synthetic corruption, up to 40 epochs each, AdamW lr 0.001, batch 64, validation every 10, patience 3. Equal budget, not identical on-policy states.
stateValueStudy.selection: Existing benchmark_normalized Dev selector. Frozen Test and retail holdout outcomes are excluded.
stateValueStudy.promotion: Across all three seeds, generated and retail actual mean loss must not exceed forecast-v1; no lower final parameter/evidence accuracy, no increase in unnecessary or missed requests or invalid handoffs. At least one loss or request improvement is required. Keep the parent if these gates fail.
stateValueStudy.limitations: Generated Dev has 60 examples/12 families. Retail exact losses use five observed periods times seven controlled conditions. No real organizational or demand-calibration claim.
